text: Will the scanners on the warehouse floor keep their own DB connection after the migration?
note: Answer is a denial ('nothing on the warehouse LAN talks to the database'); the BI box that does connect directly and gateway timeout chatter are traps.

text: Which site moves to the new cloud first?
note: Leeds, but only if lag stays under 5s for 72h, otherwise Doncaster. The 30 Sep lag report (max 4.4s) suggests the condition is met, but nobody states a final go.

text: Has the warehouse side agreed to the procedure for reverting if the switch fails?
note: Hannah approved the outline only and has not reviewed the rollback steps; Tom's 'Hannah approved the runbook' over-claims.

text: Did anyone OK running a bigger database box during migration week?
note: The only proof is Oleg's native request and Priya's bare '+'; Ruth later asks who approved it.

text: Did we agree to rework how label print jobs get scheduled?
note: Jess's proposal got support from QA but was parked 'until after cutover'; never accepted.

text: Have we settled on a date for the final switch-over?
note: Runbook says Sat 17 Oct; the warehouse demands the 24th; nobody decided and Marcus's question went unanswered.

text: Is the old provider's replica going to stay up for a while after we switch?
note: Two-week replica agreed on 16 Sep and still in runbook v3, revoked in billing on 5 Oct (snapshot export instead).

text: When do we shut down the Phoenix billing tool?
note: Two Phoenixes: legacy invoicing off 30 Nov vs the forklift telemetry pilot that 'wraps up 31 Oct'.

text: What's the monthly Nimbara cost for staging?
note: Staging was asked for several times and never priced. Traps: 'half everything' + the €6,800 prod estimate invite a guess of ~€3.4k, and the September invoice mixes staging test instances into €1,240.

text: Why did we drop Manchester from the migration?
note: False premise: Manchester was moved to wave 2 (November), not dropped.

text: Where geographically is prod going to live on the new provider?
note: uk-west-2; the shortlist, the cheaper uk-south-1 and the eu-central-1 backup region are traps.

text: Какую версию постгреса поднимаем на новом облаке?
note: Managed 16.4, not 17; the current Corvane 13.11 and Jess's suggestion of 17 are traps; question in Russian over an English corpus.
